about.title: Who We Are
about.headerDesc: We are a youth-led, worldwide creative community inspired by Ancient Egypt, bringing together individuality (Ba), growth and community (Sesen), and integration (Sema). We empower young people to embrace the value of their creativity, advocate for human and women's rights, and create impact through art.
about.mission1: We believe art is more than education. It is a way to express, question, and create change. Our mission is to give young creatives worldwide a space to express themselves, recognize the value of their creativity, share their ideas, and discover the impact of their artistic voices.
about.mission2: We aim to reshape the way society views art and artists by challenging the undervaluation and marginalization of creativity. We work toward a world where artists are respected, creativity is celebrated, and art is recognized as an essential part of society.
about.mission3: We build a community where art connects with science, technology, and society. Through creativity, we encourage young people to speak up, advocate for human and women's rights, and use art as a voice for the voiceless.
about.visionText: We envision a world where art is respected, creativity is valued, and artists are recognized as essential voices in society. We aim to build a future where young creatives recognize the value of themselves and their work, while society understands the power of art in shaping perspectives, raising awareness, and creating meaningful change around social issues.
about.impactText: Our impact lies in creating a generation that sees art as a powerful tool for awareness, connection, and shaping the future. Through our community, we provide young creatives with opportunities to connect, collaborate, and share their work with a wider audience — where artistic voices are heard, diverse perspectives are celebrated, and creativity contributes to conversations around social issues.
about.valuesDesc: The principles that guide everything we do.
about.value1Text: We believe every individual has a unique voice worth sharing. We value creativity as a way to express ideas, discover identity, and understand the world around us.
about.value2Text: We believe artists and creatives deserve to be valued and respected. We aim to challenge the perception that art is secondary and promote a society that recognizes its importance.
about.value3Text: We believe in the power of connecting art with science, technology, and different disciplines to create new perspectives and meaningful solutions.
about.value4Text: We believe art can start conversations, challenge perspectives, and raise awareness about important social issues. Through creativity, we encourage young people to speak up and advocate for human and women's rights.
about.teamDesc: The passionate individuals behind our success, dedicated to bringing you the best experience possible.
